cells.value:
# Execution quality: daily TCA

**Variables** (Variables button): `day` is the session as a TICK string (`'2026-11-11'`, or `'$yesterday'` to always show the last session). `event` is a window to isolate a market event. `chart_window` is the span for the cross-market chart.

**How to read it.** Markout = side × (venue mid at fill + horizon − fill price) / price, in bps. **Positive is good for us.** Exchange fills are marked against their own venue's quotes. BROKER/OTC trades are marked against the primary listing (WTI→CME, TTF/EUA→ICE Endex, others→ICE) at **trade time**, not booking time. A healthy book has aggressive fills near −½ spread and passive fills near +½ spread, staying flat over 1s–1m. Being *picked off* shows as passive markouts falling below zero within seconds. USD uses fixed FX (EURUSD 1.107, GBPUSD 1.3287; NBP is in pence). 5m+ horizons mix in market direction, so read them alongside the cross-market chart.

**Findings for 11 Nov 2026:** (1) No systematic pick-off on exchange fills. Aggressive fills pay about −1.2 bps and passive fills earn about +1.2 bps, both flat from −5s to +10s and in line with 10 Nov. (2) The weak spot is NBP passive: it captures +0.05 bps against a 0.5 bps half-spread, and fills in the Q1-27/Q2-27 strips trade through mid. (3) The gas/power rally from 09:28 to 09:52 (NBP +6.5%, JKM +5.8%, TTF +4.3%, UKPWR +3.8%, Brent flat) creates ±100–200 bps 5-minute markouts. That is market move, not execution. (4) BROKER/OTC tickets are booked 12 min to 24 h late. Timed at booking, prices look 27–45 bps off market; timed at trade they are fine.

SELECT h.offset / 1000000000.0 AS horizon_s,
  avg(CASE WHEN NOT f.passive THEN sign(f.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) / f.px * 10000 END) AS aggressive_bps,
  avg(CASE WHEN f.passive THEN sign(f.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) / f.px * 10000 END) AS passive_bps
FROM energy_fills f
HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source)
LIST (-60s, -10s, -1s, 0, 1s, 10s, 60s, 300s, 900s, 1800s) AS h
WHERE f.ts IN @day
GROUP BY horizon_s ORDER BY horizon_s
cells.name: Markout curve: all exchange fills (bps, + = good for us)

cells.value:
SELECT ts, symbol, 100 * (mid / first_value(mid) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY ts) - 1) AS pct_move
FROM (
  SELECT ts, symbol, last((bid + ask) / 2) AS mid FROM energy_quotes
  WHERE ts IN @chart_window
    AND ((symbol IN ('NBP_Q1-27','JKM_Jan-27','UKPWR_Q1-27','BRENT_Jan-27') AND source = 'ICE')
      OR (symbol = 'TTF_Q1-27' AND source = 'ICE_ENDEX'))
  SAMPLE BY 1m
) ORDER BY ts
cells.name: Cross-market move: % from window start (common move vs pick-off)

cells.value:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT ts, symbol, curve, venue, passive, qty, px,
    (CASE WHEN curve = 'NBP' THEN 0.01 ELSE 1.0 END)
    * (CASE WHEN curve IN ('TTF','EUA') THEN 1.107 WHEN curve IN ('NBP','UKPWR','UKA') THEN 1.3287 ELSE 1.0 END) AS usd_f
  FROM energy_fills WHERE ts IN @day
)
SELECT f.curve, f.venue, CASE WHEN f.passive THEN 'passive' ELSE 'aggressive' END AS side,
  count() / 5 AS fills,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN h.offset = 0 THEN abs(f.qty) * f.px * f.usd_f END) / 1e6, 1) AS notional_usd_m,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 0 THEN (q.ask - q.bid) / ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2) * 5000 END), 2) AS half_spread_bps,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 0 THEN sign(f.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) / f.px * 10000 END), 2) AS mk_0_bps,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 1000000000 THEN sign(f.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) / f.px * 10000 END), 2) AS mk_1s_bps,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 10000000000 THEN sign(f.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) / f.px * 10000 END), 2) AS mk_10s_bps,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 60000000000 THEN sign(f.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) / f.px * 10000 END), 2) AS mk_1m_bps,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 300000000000 THEN sign(f.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) / f.px * 10000 END), 2) AS mk_5m_bps,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN h.offset = 0 THEN f.qty * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) * f.usd_f END)) AS usd_at_fill,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN h.offset = 60000000000 THEN f.qty * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) * f.usd_f END)) AS usd_1m,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN h.offset = 300000000000 THEN f.qty * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) * f.usd_f END)) AS usd_5m
FROM f
HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source)
LIST (0, 1s, 10s, 60s, 300s) AS h
GROUP BY f.curve, f.venue, side
ORDER BY side, mk_1m_bps
cells.name: Scorecard by curve × venue × aggressive/passive

cells.value:
SELECT f.trader, f.book,
  sum(CASE WHEN h.offset = 0 AND NOT f.passive THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aggr_fills,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 0 AND NOT f.passive THEN sign(f.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) / f.px * 10000 END), 2) AS aggr_mk_0,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 10000000000 AND NOT f.passive THEN sign(f.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) / f.px * 10000 END), 2) AS aggr_mk_10s,
  sum(CASE WHEN h.offset = 0 AND f.passive THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pass_fills,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 0 AND f.passive THEN sign(f.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) / f.px * 10000 END), 2) AS pass_mk_0,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 10000000000 AND f.passive THEN sign(f.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) / f.px * 10000 END), 2) AS pass_mk_10s,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 60000000000 AND f.passive THEN sign(f.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) / f.px * 10000 END), 2) AS pass_mk_1m
FROM energy_fills f
HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source)
LIST (0, 10s, 60s) AS h
WHERE f.ts IN @day
GROUP BY f.trader, f.book
ORDER BY pass_mk_10s
cells.name: Trader scorecard (exchange fills)

cells.value:
SELECT f.curve, f.symbol, count() / 2 AS passive_fills,
  sum(CASE WHEN h.offset = 0 AND sign(f.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS through_mid,
  round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN h.offset = 0 AND sign(f.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / (count() / 2), 0) AS through_pct,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 0 THEN (q.ask - q.bid) / ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2) * 5000 END), 2) AS half_spread_bps,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 0 THEN sign(f.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) / f.px * 10000 END), 2) AS mk_0_bps,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 60000000000 THEN sign(f.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) / f.px * 10000 END), 2) AS mk_1m_bps
FROM energy_fills f
HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source)
LIST (0, 60s) AS h
WHERE f.ts IN @day AND f.passive
GROUP BY f.curve, f.symbol
ORDER BY mk_0_bps
LIMIT 20
cells.name: Passive fills that traded through mid (stale-quote check), by symbol

cells.value:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT ts, symbol, curve, venue, passive, qty, px,
    CASE WHEN ts IN @event THEN '1 event window' ELSE '2 rest of day' END AS period,
    (CASE WHEN curve = 'NBP' THEN 0.01 ELSE 1.0 END)
    * (CASE WHEN curve IN ('TTF','EUA') THEN 1.107 WHEN curve IN ('NBP','UKPWR','UKA') THEN 1.3287 ELSE 1.0 END) AS usd_f
  FROM energy_fills WHERE ts IN @day AND curve IN ('NBP','TTF','UKPWR','JKM')
)
SELECT f.period, CASE WHEN f.qty > 0 THEN 'buy' ELSE 'sell' END AS dir,
  CASE WHEN f.passive THEN 'passive' ELSE 'aggressive' END AS side, count() / 4 AS fills,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 0 THEN sign(f.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) / f.px * 10000 END), 2) AS mk_0_bps,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 1000000000 THEN sign(f.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) / f.px * 10000 END), 2) AS mk_1s_bps,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 60000000000 THEN sign(f.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) / f.px * 10000 END), 2) AS mk_1m_bps,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 300000000000 THEN sign(f.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) / f.px * 10000 END), 2) AS mk_5m_bps,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN h.offset = 300000000000 THEN f.qty * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px) * f.usd_f END)) AS usd_5m
FROM f
HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source)
LIST (0, 1s, 60s, 300s) AS h
GROUP BY f.period, dir, side
ORDER BY f.period, dir, side
cells.name: Event window vs rest of day (gas/power fills): both directions move with the market

cells.value:
WITH otc AS (
  SELECT trade_ts, symbol, curve, qty, px, channel, counterparty,
    CASE WHEN curve = 'WTI' THEN 'CME' WHEN curve IN ('TTF','EUA') THEN 'ICE_ENDEX' ELSE 'ICE' END AS src,
    (CASE WHEN curve = 'NBP' THEN 0.01 ELSE 1.0 END)
    * (CASE WHEN curve IN ('TTF','EUA') THEN 1.107 WHEN curve IN ('NBP','UKPWR','UKA') THEN 1.3287 ELSE 1.0 END) AS usd_f
  FROM energy_trade_events
  WHERE trade_ts IN @day AND version = 1 AND channel <> 'EXCH'
  ORDER BY trade_ts
), otc_ts AS (SELECT * FROM otc TIMESTAMP(trade_ts))
SELECT t.counterparty, count() / 4 AS trades, string_agg(DISTINCT t.channel, ',') AS channels,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 0 THEN sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000 END), 2) AS mk_0_bps,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 60000000 THEN sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000 END), 2) AS mk_1m_bps,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 300000000 THEN sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000 END), 2) AS mk_5m_bps,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 1800000000 THEN sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000 END), 2) AS mk_30m_bps,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN h.offset = 300000000 THEN t.qty * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) * t.usd_f END)) AS usd_5m
FROM otc_ts t
HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.src = q.source)
LIST (0, 60s, 300s, 1800s) AS h
GROUP BY t.counterparty
ORDER BY mk_5m_bps
cells.name: BROKER / OTC counterparties: markout at trade time

cells.value:
WITH bk AS (
  SELECT booked_ts, trade_ts, symbol, curve, qty, px, channel,
    CASE WHEN curve = 'WTI' THEN 'CME' WHEN curve IN ('TTF','EUA') THEN 'ICE_ENDEX' ELSE 'ICE' END AS src
  FROM energy_trade_events WHERE trade_ts IN @day AND version = 1
)
SELECT b.channel, count() AS trades,
  round(avg(datediff('s', b.trade_ts, b.booked_ts)) / 60.0, 1) AS avg_booking_lag_min,
  round(max(datediff('s', b.trade_ts, b.booked_ts)) / 3600.0, 1) AS max_booking_lag_h,
  sum(CASE WHEN timestamp_floor('d', b.booked_ts) > timestamp_floor('d', b.trade_ts) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS booked_next_day,
  round(avg(sign(b.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - b.px) / b.px * 10000), 2) AS mk_if_timed_at_booking_bps,
  round(avg(abs((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - b.px) / b.px * 10000), 1) AS abs_px_vs_mid_at_booking_bps
FROM bk b
HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (b.symbol = q.symbol AND b.src = q.source)
LIST (0) AS h
GROUP BY b.channel
cells.name: Booking lag: why timing on booked_ts looks like being picked off

cells.value:
SELECT e2.booked_ts, e2.status, e2.reason, e2.channel, e2.counterparty, e2.symbol, e2.trader,
  e1.qty AS qty_v1, e2.qty AS qty_now, e1.px AS px_v1, e2.px AS px_now, e2.booked_by
FROM energy_trade_events e2
JOIN energy_trade_events e1 ON e1.trade_id = e2.trade_id AND e1.version = 1
WHERE e2.version > 1 AND e2.trade_ts IN @day
ORDER BY e2.booked_ts
cells.name: Amendments & cancellations (booking hygiene)
